transcript: This public message contains a rule and a reason. Welcome to the Music Practice Day tour at the train station. We will first visit the model room, then the photo hall, and finally the workshop. Photography is allowed in the first two rooms but not in the workshop. Keep your ticket because the guide will check it at the last door.
